name: pi-sandbox
notes: Forked from carderne/pi-sandbox. The fork adds optional pi-tool-display bash rendering decoration (falling back to built-in rendering when pi-tool-display is absent), named sandbox profiles for subagents, the per-session SandboxService profile layer, network.disabled, and protectNonexistentFiles passthrough. The project-scoped profile contract lives in openspec (change add-project-scoped-profiles, spec project-sandbox-profiles).

knownDebt.reason: Upstream lockfile deleted on every pull (git rm packages/pi-sandbox/pnpm-lock.yaml packages/pi-sandbox/pnpm-workspace.yaml); unconsumed by this pnpm monorepo.
Upstream workspace file deleted on every pull; the package is a member of the root pnpm workspace instead.

The fork wraps these upstream-origin calls in its own try/catch seam, so the deeper indentation is required by the fork structure; restoring upstream bytes fails `oxfmt --check`, the package's own formatter gate.
